newsitem.title: USA: Alpharma sees share loss, talks with lenders.
newsitem.headline: Alpharma sees share loss, talks with lenders.

text.p: Alpharma Inc said on Tuesday it foresaw a fourth quarter loss of $0.30 a share and had started talks with lenders to modify loan covenants.

The pharmaceutical company said in a statement sales for its U.S. Pharmaceutical Division for the quarter ended December 31 were markedly lower than last year, as the division continues to be hurt "by the dramatic shift in industry distribution, purchasing and stocking patterns" in the drugs industry.
The company said it estimated a fourth quarter loss of about $0.30 per share. Alpharma reported a fourth quarter diluted share profit of $0.25 in the same period last year.
Alpharma will record a charge of $0.10 a share in the fourth quarter because of "re-evaluation of its business practices in its U.S. business units."

Alpharma has begun to recall some lots of four products: Guiatuss AC and DAC, Dihistine expectorant and Lidocaine. The recall will be for internal quality control, storage requirements and because of expirations.
The company has started talks "with its major bank syndicate to modify existing loan covenants and seek additional loan capacity to afford the company greater flexibility," the statement said.
"The company is also evaluating various equity-related strategies to create additional flexibility."
It added, "Consistent with its corporate strategy, the company has been reviewing acquisition possibilities and/or combination transactions for its businesses, both in the U.S. and abroad.

"... although Alpharma continues to have discussions regarding such transactions, it stated that currently no definitive agreements have been reached nor can there be any assurance that any agreements will be reached."
